reviews.text:
Dale and his team did an amazing job working with us on our Granbury home plans.  We are now ready to break ground on what has been our dream home for about 8 years.  Dale was quickly in sync with our vision and made it an even better reality.

I would highly recommend Grand Home Designs.

I confidently recommend Grand Home Design for their outstanding creativity, meticulous attention to design, and ability to bring innovative concepts to life. Working with Dale guarantees a unique and visually stunning architectural masterpiece.

Dale was amazing throughout the entire process. Watching him literally draw out a house by what you tell him from your imagination ... it is truly extraordinary. Every thing you can ask for or want, they can do. The entire staff is really friendly, and GIna is prompt, answers all emails and calls in a timely manner, and they truly cater to you. If I ever build again, you can bet I will use Grand Home Designs, and I highly recommend them.

- L. Rollins
We have used Grand Home Designs for three different significant home remodels, add on. Highly recommend them as someone who has great ideas and is great to work with.
The team at Grand Home Designs are awesome. They are all highly skilled and extremely knowledgeable and produce beautiful work. I would recommend them to anyone!
Get designers! Mitch is one of the best! If you're looking for a custom home designer, I highly recommend this company.
Such a wonderful experience! Mitch is a great architect!
Wouldn't use anyone else!

Hello Ofelia,

We are always seeking to provide the best customer service possible for our clients. If there is anything we can do to help with any issues you may have had when using our services, please contact us by phone or e-mail at your convenience.

Thank you,

Grand Home Designs
817-696-0520
gina@grandhomedesigns.com

Dale and his team did an amazing job working with us on our Granbury home plans.  We are now ready to break ground on what has been our dream home for about 8 years.  Dale was quickly in sync with our vision and made it an even better reality.

I would highly recommend Grand Home Designs.

I confidently recommend Grand Home Design for their outstanding creativity, meticulous attention to design, and ability to bring innovative concepts to life. Working with Dale guarantees a unique and visually stunning architectural masterpiece.

Dale was amazing throughout the entire process. Watching him literally draw out a house by what you tell him from your imagination ... it is truly extraordinary. Every thing you can ask for or want, they can do. The entire staff is really friendly, and GIna is prompt, answers all emails and calls in a timely manner, and they truly cater to you. If I ever build again, you can bet I will use Grand Home Designs, and I highly recommend them.

- L. Rollins
We have used Grand Home Designs for three different significant home remodels, add on. Highly recommend them as someone who has great ideas and is great to work with.
The team at Grand Home Designs are awesome. They are all highly skilled and extremely knowledgeable and produce beautiful work. I would recommend them to anyone!
Get designers! Mitch is one of the best! If you're looking for a custom home designer, I highly recommend this company.
Such a wonderful experience! Mitch is a great architect!
Wouldn't use anyone else!

data.summary: The reviews show strong signs of inauthenticity, primarily due to identical 5-star reviews being posted on two separate Google profiles. The language is often generic and promotional. While the business is long-established, the extremely low and duplicated review count is suspicious. The lack of any detailed negative feedback in the sample is also unusual.
fake_signals: Identical reviews across two Google profiles
Generic, corporate-sounding language in many reviews
Low total review volume for a 25-year-old business
Lack of specific project details in most reviews
authentic_signals: Some reviews mention specific staff (Dale, Mitch, Gina)
One review mentions a specific location (Granbury)
Reviews span 9 years, showing a timeline
complaint_patterns: No substantive complaints found in sample
data.discrepancy_explanation: The Google Maps Local and HQ reviews are nearly identical, suggesting potential duplication or copying. The company has an A+ BBB rating but minimal review volume on other platforms, creating an inconsistent profile.
